corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the right-side 2nd-order stroke of ዱ ('ማለዱት' = 'they besought Him', translating 'ወአስተብቍዕዎ'), not ዳ.
'መላልሰው' is a complete word at the end of line 36 followed by 'ደም' on line 37, so it does not wrap mid-word.
The glyph is 6th-order ር ('ይጠብቁ ነበርና'), matching both the visual top bend of ር and plural verb agreement.
